name: Button
summary: Marketing call-to-action buttons for the landing sites. These FOLLOW the product Button contract (aha-button): primary, secondary, pink-accent and text-link variants at the DS default 8px radius (--aha-radius-default) and the large control height — the same shape and size as both the product Button and the current live marketing buttons, so the preview reads as the buttons the site ships today. Colour, size, radius and motion all bind to the DS Button tokens. On a product surface reuse <aha-button> itself; on a framework-free marketing page paste this anchor form. Uses the DS elevation token, the product component's soft box-shadow focus ring (--aha-button-focus-ring), and the secondary variant's hover text-colour and press-border states from aha-button.js. The fourth variant, text-link (Webflow calls this its "Text link" component — the live site's tertiary CTA), is a borderless label in brand purple that reuses the product's own text-link colour tokens (--aha-color-primary / --aha-text-link-hover) and the same shared focus ring, kept at the landing family's semibold weight for visual consistency alongside the other three CTAs.
html: Primary Secondary Pink Text link
previewHtml:
